description:
Su-yeon, a college student who has been married to the heir of K-group in a contract arrangement, is ready to get a divorce after three long years of survival. 

“We’re going to get divorced anyway, so let’s try to improve our relationship. So at least you won’t have any regrets.” 

Her husband, Ji-hyeok, goes on the attack, as if he were really trying to date Su-yeon again. Although she promised herself that she will not fall for him, her heart keeps wavering…

A woman who dreams of sweet love some place far away, and a man who won't let her go. Can the two really become true couple? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
